theory.heading: What AWS Developer Associate Capstone is
theory.body: AWS Developer Associate Capstone describes the methods and patterns used within AWS Developer Associate to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.body: Without AWS Developer Associate Capstone, systems built with AWS Developer Associate are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How AWS Developer Associate Capstone works
theory.body: The mechanism behind AWS Developer Associate Capstone follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of AWS Developer Associate Capstone
theory.body: AWS Developer Associate Capstone offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
